team_luck.note: z is residual wins vs the rating's expectation, divided by the standard error of the sum. Outside +/-2 means the team has run hot or cold beyond what the rating explains; strategies leaning on such a team are not publishable.

flags.fix: capture a per-date team-statistics history, or restrict B's backtest to games on or after the snapshot
